chibi-dwarf-monument.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:DWARF
chibi-dwarf-monument.notes: Reused candidate 2 of the Dwarf Explorer sheet (explorer-a), no new PixelLab job (the US$5 limit left no room for obelisk-a). A tall obelisk of warm grey stone blocks carved with runes, banded with two copper rings, a small iron lantern hanging from its upper left; no compass rose, no telescope, so it shows the Dwarf builder and hides the achievement. Lit from the left. 15 has a copper dial that reads like a rose; 0, 8 and 13 stand by a telescope.

chibi-dwarf-monument-conqueror.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:DWARF:CONQUEROR
chibi-dwarf-monument-conqueror.notes: Candidate 15 of 16: a heavy round arch of soot-dark stone blocks banded with dark iron, an open gateway, and a copper laurel wreath round a crossed axe and hammer on its front; the Conqueror's arch and wreath in Dwarf stone and iron. The only one of sixteen not lit from the right by the faces measure (+1.4, flat): every square arch (0 to 14) is shaded on its left; the wreath sits on the lintel's face, not on top.

chibi-dwarf-monument-engineer.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:DWARF:ENGINEER
chibi-dwarf-monument-engineer.notes: Candidate 6 of 16 (resumed after a dropped poll): a square pillar of soot-dark stone under a big brass cogwheel standing on its edge, copper pipes up both sides and a crossed hammer and spanner on its front; the Engineer's cog and crossed tools in Dwarf iron, copper and brass. It is the only one of sixteen whose faces measure is not lit from the right (-0.6, flat); 3 and 7 have warmer grey stone but are shaded on their left.

chibi-dwarf-monument-explorer.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:DWARF:EXPLORER
chibi-dwarf-monument-explorer.notes: Candidate 4 of 16: an obelisk of warm grey stone blocks banded with copper, a big brass compass rose with a four-pointed star on its front and a brass telescope on a dark iron tripod at its foot; the Explorer's compass and spyglass in Dwarf stone, copper and brass, lit from the left. 3 and 7 a smaller star; 0, 1, 5, 8 and 11 no rose; 10 a cairn; 13 and 14 a lantern.

chibi-dwarf-monument-land-baron.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:DWARF:LAND_BARON
chibi-dwarf-monument-land-baron.notes: Candidate 2 of 16: a stout boundary stone of warm grey stone blocks with a carved shield on its front, a big brass crown on its flat top and a dark iron signpost with two arrow boards; the Land Baron's crowned boundary stone and signpost in Dwarf stone, iron and brass, lit from the left. 0, 4 and 6 are close with a smaller crown; 3, 7 and 15 dark stone; 9 and 12 no shield; 13 an iron crown.

chibi-dwarf-monument-muster.subject: IMPROVEMENT:MONUMENT:DWARF:MUSTER
chibi-dwarf-monument-muster.notes: Candidate 13 of 16: a warm grey stone pillar with two round copper shields at its foot and a big brass war horn across its flat top; the Muster's shields under a horn in Dwarf stone, copper and brass, lit from the left. 5 and 9 are close with one shield; 1, 4 and 14 dark iron pillars; 7, 11 and 15 a plain stone with one kite shield.
